description: A painterly, dark-toned laboratory scene. A large glass bottle in the centre is crowded with small fruit flies and has a yellow-brown food mass at its base. A hand holds a brass magnifying glass over the bottle, and the lens shows a fly with two others nearby. Behind it are wooden shelves of smaller bottles with cotton plugs, retort stands and glassware in warm lamplight. A notebook with scribbled pages and a screwdriver lie on the bench at the bottom. No legible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
